What you'll be doing

 * Train venues together with the Onboarding team, providing them with all the tools and information to start working as soon as possible

 * Gather feedback from partners and translate it into product, marketing, and operations improvements

 * Act as a key communicator between operations and retail partners

 * Collaborate with the marketing team to plan and execute campaigns with retail partners

Our humble expectations

 * Experience in account management or business development with clear commercial impact.

 * Proven ownership of a small, high-value retail portfolio and a portfolio of initiatives, delivering results with minimal guidance.

 * Advanced analytics in Looker or Power BI, plus strong spreadsheet skills, used to steer negotiations and campaigns.

 * Skilled negotiator who drives adoption of solutions and crafts data-driven business cases.

 * Excellent stakeholder management across HQ, regional and store levels, influencing without authority.

 *  Good language skills in German and English

What we offer

 *  Independent work in a dynamic, international team

 *  Employee Assistance Programme - therapy and wellbeing

 *  Discount on your Wolt orders

 *  My Clubs partnership with discounted rates for your monthly sports program

 *  Modern work equipment

 *  Hybrid working (2 home office days per week)

 * Team building, sport and company events multiple times a year

We offer an attractive salary starting at 55 000€ p.a. (40h/week) which is adjusted and increased depending how well you go through the process.

Why you'll love it

 * Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving scaleup

 * Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build your sales skills

 * You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures.
 * You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components.

 * You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines.
 * You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware.
 * You work on research and development projects, prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues.
 * You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders.
 * You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.
